Context: A. If Exonerated

## A. If Exonerated  
- Where the Competent Authority is of the opinion that the suspension was wholly unjustified, the Government servant may
- (a) be paid full pay and allowances.
- (b) Where the Competent Authority is of the opinion that the proceedings were delayed for reasons directly attributable to the Government servant, it may after notice to the Government servant and considering his representation, if any, order a reduced amount to be paid.
